How it works

  1. 1

    Club type

    Drivers, fairway woods, hybrids and utility irons, or a set of irons.

  2. 2

    Brand

    Callaway, Mizuno, PXG, Srixon, TaylorMade, Wilson.

  3. 3

    Model

    Pick the head you want. Each model shows the options it can be built with.

  4. 4

    Build

    Set it up your way, then add it to your basket like anything else.

  5. 5

    We build and send it

    Your clubs are built to order and dispatched in 2 to 3 weeks, then delivered free across the UK.

What you can set

  • LoftDrivers, woods and utility irons, e.g. 9°, 10.5° or 12°
  • Set make-up5-PW (6 irons), 4-PW (7 irons), 5-PW + SW (7 irons)
  • ShaftSteel or graphite, from the shafts each model is offered with
  • FlexLadies, Senior, Regular, Stiff or Extra Stiff, depending on the shaft
  • Lie, length and gripAdjustable in the builder

Questions

How long does a custom build take?

Clubs are built to order and dispatched in 2 to 3 weeks, then delivered free across the UK.

Do upgrades cost extra?

Prices include the standard shaft and grip; any upgrades are priced in the builder.

Can I return a custom build?

Returns on custom builds to be confirmed. Standard, off-the-shelf clubs are covered by our normal returns policy.

What warranty do custom builds have?

Manufacturer warranty applies to custom builds; wording to be confirmed

Do I need a fitting first?

No. You can build with standard specs, use specs from a previous fitting, or ask our team. A free fitting is there if you want one.

Can I build left-handed?

Yes. 45 models come in left-handed: 8 drivers, 6 fairway woods, 1 hybrids & utility irons, 30 irons. Choose “Left-handed” above before you pick a type.
